streamer.label: Streamer mode
streamer.description: A panel where members deafen themselves (without muting their mic) to stream a game to friends.

feedback.disabled: ❌ Streamer mode is disabled on this server.
feedback.notConfigured: ❌ No Streaming role is configured (an admin must set it on the dashboard).
feedback.roleGone: ❌ The Streaming role no longer exists.
feedback.cannot: ⚠️ I can't: I'm missing « Deafen Members » or « Manage Roles », or the Streaming role is above mine.
feedback.enabledUser: 🎙️ **Streamer mode enabled.** You no longer hear Discord, but your mic keeps broadcasting.
feedback.disabledUser: 🔊 **Streamer mode disabled.** You can hear Discord again.

g0.label: 🎥 Streamer mode
g0.description: After any change, republish the panel with the “Publish” button.

roleId.label: “Live” role
roleId.help: Worn by members who have turned streamer mode on, and removed when they turn it off. It acts as a visible marker in the member list, and shows who is currently broadcasting.

channelId.label: Panel channel
channelId.help: The channel the button panel is posted in. The panel does not appear on its own: once the channel is chosen, send it with the « Publish panel » button.

title.label: Panel title
title.help: The panel's title. Changing it does not update an already published panel: republish it for the existing message to be rewritten.

description.label: Panel description
description.help: The panel's body text, under the title. This is where you explain what streamer mode does — deafening you to others while still broadcasting your mic — before somebody clicks without knowing.
